properties.entry: select a.req_id,a.from_date,a.to_date,a.req_date,a.status,a.purpose,a.nor_req,a.nob_g_req,a.nod_g_req,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,d.quota_desc,b.gh_name,c.block_name,c.block_id,c.block_id,e.item_title, a.can_status,f.feedback_id from gad_request a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join quota d on a.category_type = d.quota_type join m_purpose_items e on e.item_id = a.purpose left join feedback_system f on a.req_id = f.req_id where userid=?
update gad_request set status=?,req_date=now(), cancelled_by = ? where userid=? and req_id=?

select a.during_stay_conveancy,a.req_id,gd.name,d.category,a.nod_g_req,a.nor_req,e.desg_category as desg,a.mobile_no,a.nob_g_req,a.req_date,a.address,a.from_date,a.to_date,a.status,f.item_title as purpose,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,d.quota_desc,b.gh_name,c.block_name from gad_request a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join quota d on a.category_type = d.quota_type join visitor_category e on a.desg = e.vc_id join m_purpose_items f on a.purpose = f.item_id join guest_details gd on a.req_id =gd.req_id where userid=? and a.req_id=?

select a.req_id,a.from_date,a.to_date,a.status,a.purpose,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,d.quota_desc,b.gh_name,c.block_name,c.block_id from gad_request a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join quota d on a.category_type = d.quota_type where userid=? and status='CIN' and (date(now()) between date(from_date) and date(to_date))

select count(*) from (select a.req_id,a.from_date,a.to_date,a.status,a.purpose,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1, d.quota_desc,b.gh_name,c.block_name,c.block_id from gad_request a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join quota d on a.category_type = d.quota_type where userid=? and status='ALO' and date(now()) <= a.from_date::date - interval'1 day')as cancelList

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.req_id,b.from_date) b.req_id, b.req_date, c.name, b.from_date, b.to_date, c.designation, b.mobile_no, b.email_id, b.status, c.guest_id, c.age, c.gender, c.department, b.address, b.can_status FROM gad_request AS b JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS a WHERE a.row_number = 1) AS c ON b.req_id = c.req_id WHERE b.roomtype NOT IN ('CON', 'C') AND ((b.status = 'PRO' AND COALESCE(b.can_status, '') != 'PCAN') OR (b.status = 'CIN' AND (b.to_date::date - b.from_date::date) != 1 AND COALESCE(b.can_status, '') != 'PCAN')) AND NOW()::DATE <= b.to_date::DATE

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.req_id,b.from_date) b.req_id,b.req_date,a.name,b.from_date,b.to_date, a.designation,b.mobile_no, b.email_id, b.status, a.guest_id,a.age,a.gender,a.department,b.address, b.can_status, b.no_of_days, (case when (n.req_id is not null OR c.req_id is not null) then 1 else 0 end) as partial_c from gad_request as b join (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS c WHERE c.row_number = 1) AS a on b.req_id=a.req_id left join partial_cancel_request c on b.req_id = c.req_id left join noc_table n on b.req_id = n.req_id

SELECT a.req_id,a.req_date,COALESCE(c.from_date, COALESCE(n.from_date, a.from_date)) AS from_date,COALESCE(c.to_date, a.to_date) AS to_date, d.name,a.mobile_no,a.email_id,a.status,a.can_status, (CASE WHEN (n.req_id IS NOT null OR c.req_id IS NOT null) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_c FROM gad_request AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY SUBSTRING(guest_id,3)) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS b WHERE b.row_number = 1) AS d ON a.req_id = d.req_id LEFT JOIN partial_cancel_request c on d.req_id = c.req_id LEFT JOIN noc_table n on n.req_id = a.req_id

select count(*) from (select a.req_id,a.from_date,a.to_date,a.status,a.purpose,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1, d.quota_desc,b.gh_name,c.block_name,c.block_id from gad_request a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join quota d on a.category_type = d.quota_type where userid=? and status='CIN' and req_id=? and date(now()) < a.to_date::date and date(now()) >= a.from_date::date)as PartialCancelList

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gad_request where userid=? and status!='CAN' and from_date::date=?::date and to_date::date=?::date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gad_request where userid=? and status!='CAN' and from_date::date=?::date and to_date::date=?::date and req_id!=?
select * from gad_request where userid=? and req_id=?
select * from guest_details where req_id=?

INSERT INTO public.gad_request(req_id, gh_id, lastupdated, from_date, to_date, nor_req, nob_g_req, nob_l_req, status, is_veh_req, mode_of_req, purpose, ext, address, userid, req_date, nod_g_req, nod_l_req, family, mobile_no, email_id, existing_req_id, is_veh_req1, block_id, file_path, category_type, desg, roomtype,catg_file_path,during_stay_conveancy,catgtype, no_of_days, no_of_adults, no_of_children, booking_for, created_by, updated_by, updated_on, created_on) VALUES (?, ?, now(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now(), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,?,?,?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW(), NOW());

SELECT a.req_id as reqid, a.guest_id, a.name, a.age, a.gender, a.address,a.designation,a.department, a.guest_mobile, a.guest_doc_type, a.guest_doc_path FROM public.guest_details a join public.gad_request b on a.req_id= b.req_id WHERE a.req_id = ? ORDER BY SUBSTRING(a.guest_id, 3) ASC

SELECT t1.req_id, t1.gh_id,t1.roomtype, t1.lastupdated, t1.from_date, t1.to_date, t1.nor_req, t1.nob_g_req, t1.nob_l_req, t1.status,coalesce(t1.can_status,'CAN') as can_status, t1.is_veh_req, t1.mode_of_req, t1.purpose, t1.ext, t1.address, t1.userid, t1.req_date, t1.nod_g_req, t1.nod_l_req, t1.roomtype, t1.family, t1.mobile_no, t1.email_id, t1.existing_req_id, t1.is_veh_req1, t1.block_id, t1.file_path, t1.category_type, t1.desg,t1.catg_file_path,t1.during_stay_conveancy,t1.catgtype, t1.no_of_days,t1.no_of_adults,t1.no_of_children,t1.booking_for, t2.veh_id, t2.mode_of_travel, t2.arrival_time, t2.arrival_place, t2.ftno, t2.arrival_date, t3.veh_id as dv_id, t3.mode_of_travel as d_mode_travel, t3.arrival_time as depr_time, t3.arrival_place as depr_place, t3.ftno as d_fno, t3.arrival_date as depr_date, t4.quota_desc, t4.category,t5.desg_category, t6.item_title, t7.gh_name, t8.block_name,coalesce(t1.ext,'') as ext FROM public.gad_request as t1 LEFT JOIN public.vehicle_req as t2 ON t1.req_id = t2.req_id LEFT JOIN public.vehicle_req1 as t3 ON t1.req_id = t3.req_id LEFT JOIN public.quota as t4 ON t1.category_type = t4.quota_type LEFT JOIN public.visitor_category as t5 ON t1.desg = t5.vc_id LEFT JOIN public.m_purpose_items as t6 ON t1.purpose = t6.item_id INNER JOIN public.gh_details as t7 ON t1.gh_id = t7.gh_id INNER JOIN public.room_block as t8 ON t1.block_id = t8.block_id WHERE t1.req_id=?

UPDATE public.gad_request SET lastupdated=now(), from_date=?, to_date=?, nor_req=?, nob_g_req=?, status=?, is_veh_req=?, purpose=?, address=?, nod_g_req=?, mobile_no=?, email_id=?, is_veh_req1=?, file_path=?, category_type=?, desg=?, roomtype=?,catg_file_path=?,during_stay_conveancy=?, catgtype=?, no_of_days=?, no_of_adults=?, no_of_children=?, booking_for=?, updated_on=NOW() WHERE req_id=?;

UPDATE public.gad_request SET gh_id=?,lastupdated=now(), from_date=?, to_date=?, nor_req=?, nob_g_req=?, status=?, is_veh_req=?, purpose=?, address=?, nod_g_req=?, mobile_no=?, email_id=?, is_veh_req1=?, block_id=?,file_path=?, category_type=?, desg=?, roomtype=? WHERE req_id=?;

UPDATE public.vehicle_req1 SET mode_of_travel=?, arrival_time=?, arrival_place=?, ftno=?, last_modified=now(), arrival_date=? WHERE req_id=? and veh_id=?;

UPDATE adminr.orisaone_data SET "BOOKING_ID"=? WHERE "REQUESTID"=?;

select a.req_id,a.req_date,a.status,a.nor_req,a.nob_g_req,a.nod_g_req,a.status,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,b.gh_name,c.block_name,c.block_id,d.arrival_time as from_date,e.arrival_time as to_date, a.category_type as quota_desc, a.desg as item_title, a.can_status, f.feedback_id from gad_request a join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join vehicle_req d on a.req_id = d.req_id join vehicle_req1 e on a.req_id = e.req_id left join feedback_system f on a.req_id = f.req_id where userid=? and a.roomtype='C'

select * from m_conveynce_mode where gh_id =? and conveynce_type=?

select a.req_id, gr.from_date, gr.to_date, gr.gh_id, gr.block_id, gr.mobile_no as guest_mobile, q.category, a.bill_id,gs.name,c.rec_id,c.total_amount,c.date_rece,c.mode,c.full_partial,rb.block_name,tb.bill_id, tb.billno, tb.date,gd.gh_name,pi.item_title, ta.room_no, ta.checkin_date, ta.checkout_date,gr.address, rb.address as gh_address,rb.contact_num,rb.mail_id as gh_mail,gr.email_id,tb.advance,tb.total , COALESCE(gr.no_of_adults,0) + COALESCE(gr.no_of_children,0) as no_of_guest ,c.amount ,e.onlyname,(tb.total::numeric - tb.advance::numeric - c.amount::numeric) AS dues_amount from (SELECT DISTINCT req_id, bill_id FROM tr_billvsguest) a join tr_receiptvsbill d on a.bill_id = d.bill_id JOIN tr_bill_master tb ON d.bill_id = tb.bill_id AND tb.status = 'RECT' join public.gad_request gr on a.req_id = gr.req_id JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON gr.req_id = gs.req_id join room_block rb on gr.block_id = rb.block_id join gh_details gd on gr.gh_id = gd.gh_id join tr_receipt c on c.rec_id = d.rec_id JOIN quota q ON q.quota_type = gr.category_type JOIN public.m_purpose_items pi on gr.purpose = pi.item_id JOIN (SELECT req_id, STRING_AGG(name, ', ') AS onlyname FROM guest_details GROUP BY req_id) AS e ON gr.req_id = e.req_id JOIN (SELECT req_id, checkin_date, checkout_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT (SELECT CONCAT(room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) END )), ',') AS room_no FROM tr_allotment WHERE status = 'COUT' GROUP BY req_id, checkin_date, checkout_date) ta ON gr.req_id = ta.req_id where a.req_id = ? and c.status='RECT' order by rec_id limit 1
select a.block_id,a.block_name,b.gh_id,b.gh_name from room_block a join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id order by block_id
select * from process_table where status='CNF' and gh_id=? and block_id=? and created_date >= now()::date order by created_date desc

select a.go_sign,a.gh_id,a.block_id,a.created_date,b.gh_name,c.block_name from process_table a join gh_details b on a.gh_id = b.gh_id join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id where a.process_id = ?

select DISTINCT on (guest_details.req_id) guest_details.*,tr_allotment.room_no,tr_allotment.room_rent,gad_request.from_date,gad_request.to_date,gad_request.purpose ,gad_request.is_veh_req,gad_request.is_veh_req1,gad_request.ext,gad_request.family,gad_request.gh_id,gad_request.block_id,gad_request.address as main_address from guest_details join gad_request on gad_request.req_id = guest_details.req_id join tr_allotment on tr_allotment.req_id=gad_request.req_id where guest_details.req_id in (select a.req_id from reservation_waitinglist a where a.par_process_id=? and status!='CAN')or guest_details.req_id in(select b.req_id from reservation_main_table b where b.process_id=? and status!='CAN') order by guest_details.req_id,guest_details.guest_id
SELECT block_id,block_name FROM public.room_block where gh_id=? ORDER BY block_id ASC
SELECT gh_id,gh_name FROM public.gh_details ORDER BY gh_id ASC

select* from (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.req_id order by b.guest_id) AS i,a.*,b.*,vc.desg_category from gad_request a join guest_details b on a.req_id=b.req_id JOIN visitor_category AS vc ON a.desg=vc.vc_id where a.req_id NOT IN(SELECT req_id from feedback_system) and a.req_id=? and a.mobile_no=? )f1 where f1.i=1

SELECT a.*, c.block_name, b.gh_name, r.role_name FROM feedback_system a LEFT JOIN room_block c ON a.block_id = c.block_id LEFT JOIN gh_details b ON a.gh_id = b.gh_id LEFT JOIN adminr.role r ON r.role_id = a.replied_by where feedback_id=? and req_id=?

select* from (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.req_id order by e.guest_id) AS i, a.req_id,a.mobile_no,to_char(a.from_date,'dd-mm-yyyy')from_date, to_char(a.to_date,'dd-mm-yyyy')to_date,to_char(a.req_date,'dd-mm-yyyy')req_date,a.status as booking_status,a.purpose,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,b.*, c.block_name,d.gh_name,f.quota_desc,e.*,vc.desg_category from gad_request a left outer join feedback_system b on a.req_id=b.req_id join room_block c on a.block_id = c.block_id join gh_details d on a.gh_id = d.gh_id join quota f on a.category_type = f.quota_type join guest_details e on a.req_id=e.req_id JOIN visitor_category AS vc ON a.desg=vc.vc_id where a.req_id=? and a.userid=? )f1 where f1.i=1

INSERT INTO public.feedback_system( feedback_id, req_id, mobile_no, gh_id, block_id, checkin_out, keep_room, quality_food, cleanliness_hygiene, conduct_of_staff, submitted_on, status, feedback_sms,overall) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, now(),?,?,?);

select distinct on(c.req_id,from_date) c.gh_id,c.category_type,c.req_date,c.req_id,c.block_id, c.from_date,c.to_date,coalesce(c.can_status,'') as can_status,c.name,c.guest_id,c.designation,c.department,c.address,c.status,d.process_id from((select req_id as rid,req_date,from_date,can_status,category_type,to_date,gh_id,status,block_id from gad_request where status in ('PRO', 'PCIN') and gh_id=? and ext in ('0','2') and block_id=?)a join (select * from guest_details)b on a.rid=b.req_id) c left join (select process_id,req_id from reservation_main_table where status!='CAN' and gh_id=? and block_id=?)d on c.rid=d.req_id
select distinct(room_no,bed_no) as roombed, room_no,bed_no,type from tr_allotment where req_id=? and status!='CAN' and block_id=?
select * from guest_details where req_id=?
select status from tr_checkin where req_id=? and guest_id=? and status!='CAN'
select a.*,rb.block_name,gd.gh_name from process_table a join room_block rb on rb.block_id = a.block_id join gh_details gd on gd.gh_id = a.gh_id where a.process_id = ?

SELECT a.req_id,a.process_id,b.name, COALESCE(d.from_date, COALESCE(n.from_date, c.from_date)) as from_date, COALESCE(d.to_date, c.to_date) AS to_date, a.status,rb.block_name,gd.gh_name,a.mode_of_cancel, ta.room_no,c.address, (CASE WHEN (n.req_id IS NOT null OR d.req_id IS NOT null) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_c FROM cancel_reservation a JOIN room_block rb ON rb.block_id = a.block_id JOIN gh_details gd ON gd.gh_id = a.gh_id JOIN (SELECT req_id, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT (SELECT CONCAT(room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) END )), ',') AS room_no FROM tr_allotment WHERE can_status IN ('FCAN', 'PCAN') GROUP BY req_id) ta ON ta.req_id = a.req_id INNER JOIN (select req_id,STRING_AGG((SELECT CONCAT(name,CASE WHEN designation <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', designation) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN department <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', department) ELSE '' END)),' & ' order by guest_id)as name from guest_details group by req_id) AS b ON a.req_id = b.req_id join gad_request c on a.req_id = c.req_id left join partial_cancel_request d on c.req_id=d.req_id LEFT JOIN noc_table n on n.req_id = a.req_id WHERE a.process_id = ?

select DISTINCT ON (a.req_id) b.req_id,b.gh_id,b.block_id,b.from_date,b.to_date ,a.guest_id,a.name,a.age,a.gender,a.designation, a.department,a.address, b.status, b.mode_of_req,b.req_date,b.mobile_no from guest_details as a join gad_request as b on b.req_id=a.req_id

SELECT b.prev_order_no,b.subject,b.prev_order_date, STRING_AGG( (SELECT CONCAT(a.prev_room_no, CASE WHEN prev_bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', prev_bed_no) END )), ',') AS prev_room_no, STRING_AGG(a.prev_room_rent,',') AS prev_room_rent , STRING_AGG( (SELECT CONCAT(a.room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) else null END )), ',') AS room_no, STRING_AGG(a.room_rent,',') AS room_rent FROM (select distinct req_id,room_no,bed_no,mod_status,room_rent,prev_room_rent,prev_room_no,prev_bed_no,status from tr_allotment) a join tr_sms_alltment b on a.req_id = b.req_id WHERE a.status NOT IN ('CAN') AND a.mod_status in('PMODF','MMODF') AND a.req_id = ? GROUP BY b.prev_order_no,b.subject,b.prev_order_date

SELECT c.req_id,d.name,c.from_date,c.to_date,b.prev_order_no,b.subject,a.status, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT (SELECT CONCAT(a.prev_room_no, CASE WHEN prev_bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', prev_bed_no) END )), ',') AS prev_room_no,SUM(a.prev_room_rent::NUMERIC) AS prev_room_rent , STRING_AGG(DISTINCT (SELECT CONCAT(a.room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) END )), ',') AS room_no,SUM(a.room_rent::NUMERIC) AS room_rent FROM tr_allotment a join tr_sms_alltment b on a.req_id = b.req_id join gad_request c on c.req_id = a.req_id INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS d ON c.req_id = d.req_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.req_id) AS total_count FROM tr_allotment a JOIN tr_sms_alltment b ON a.req_id = b.req_id JOIN gad_request c ON c.req_id = a.req_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS d ON c.req_id = d.req_id
select a.*,b.block_name,c.gh_name from tr_shift_master a join room_block b on a.block_id = b.block_id join gh_details c on a.gh_id = c.gh_id

SELECT gr.req_id, gr.req_date, gr.gh_id, gr.block_id,rb.block_name,gd.gh_name, gr.status, gr.from_date, gr.to_date, gr.roomtype, gr.mobile_no, tr.name, mch.conf_cat_desc as hall_category,tb.charge,tb.additionalcharge,tb.advance_amount, mcu.conf_use_desc as booking_type, qu.category, qu.quota_type,tr.address,tr.capacity FROM gad_request gr JOIN room_block rb on rb.block_id = gr.block_id JOIN gh_details gd on gd.gh_id = gr.gh_id JOIN tr_conf_request tr ON gr.req_id = tr.req_id JOIN tr_conf_bill tb ON gr.req_id = tb.req_id JOIN m_conf_hall_category mch ON tr.conf_cat_id = mch.conf_cat_id JOIN m_conf_hall_use mcu ON tr.conf_use_id = mcu.conf_use_id LEFT JOIN quota AS qu ON gr.category_type=qu.quota_type WHERE gr.req_id = ?

select a.req_id,a.process_id,b.name,c.from_date,c.to_date,a.status,ta.prev_order_no,ta.subject,c.address,ta.prev_order_date, ta.prev_room_no,ta.prev_room_rent,ta.room_no,ta.room_rent from modify_reservation a INNER JOIN ( select req_id,STRING_AGG((SELECT CONCAT(name,CASE WHEN designation <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', designation) ELSE '' END, CASE WHEN department <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', department) ELSE '' END)),' & ' order by guest_id)as name from guest_details group by req_id)as b on a.req_id = b.req_id join gad_request c on a.req_id = c.req_id JOIN ( SELECT c.req_id,b.prev_order_no,b.subject,b.prev_order_date, STRING_AGG( (SELECT CONCAT(c.prev_room_no, CASE WHEN prev_bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', prev_bed_no) END )), ',') AS prev_room_no, STRING_AGG(c.prev_room_rent,',') AS prev_room_rent , STRING_AGG( (SELECT CONCAT(c.room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) else null END )), ',') AS room_no, STRING_AGG(c.room_rent,',') AS room_rent FROM (select distinct req_id,room_no,bed_no,room_rent,prev_room_rent,prev_room_no,prev_bed_no,status from tr_allotment) c join tr_sms_alltment b on c.req_id = b.req_id WHERE c.status NOT IN ('CAN', 'ACAN') AND b.status='MODF' GROUP BY c.req_id,b.prev_order_no,b.subject,b.prev_order_date) AS ta ON ta.req_id = a.req_id where a.process_id = ?

SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.req_id) g.req_id, g.req_date, g.from_date,g.to_date,g.category_type, g.mobile_no, gs.name, g.status from gad_request g JOIN tr_sms_alltment s ON g.req_id = s.req_id JOIN tr_allotment a ON a.req_id = g.req_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY SUBSTRING(guest_id,3)) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON g.req_id = gs.req_id WHERE a.mod_status = 'MMODF'

SELECT gr.from_date,gr.to_date,gr.userid, gr.from_date, gr.to_date, gr.req_id, nt.noc_id, nt.noc_charge, gr.gh_id, gr.block_id,rb.block_name,gd.gh_name, nt.status, nt.rec_id, nt.pay_amount, nt.date_of_pay, gs.name,rb.address as gh_address,rb.contact_num,rb.mail_id as gh_mail,gr.mobile_no,gr.email_id ,gr.address,pi.item_title,q.category,COALESCE(gr.no_of_adults,0) + COALESCE(gr.no_of_children,0) as no_of_guest,ta.room_no FROM noc_table nt JOIN gad_request gr ON nt.req_id = gr.req_id JOIN room_block rb on rb.block_id = gr.block_id JOIN gh_details gd on gd.gh_id = gr.gh_id JOIN public.m_purpose_items pi on gr.purpose = pi.item_id JOIN quota q ON q.quota_type = gr.category_type JOIN (SELECT req_id ,STRING_AGG(DISTINCT (SELECT CONCAT(room_no, CASE WHEN bed_no IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('-', bed_no) END )), ',') AS room_no from tr_allotment WHERE can_status = 'FCAN' GROUP BY req_id) ta ON gr.req_id = ta.req_id JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY req_id ORDER BY guest_id) AS row_number FROM guest_details) AS gh_dt WHERE gh_dt.row_number = 1) AS gs ON gr.req_id = gs.req_id WHERE (gr.status = 'CAN' AND gr.can_status = '24CAN' OR gr.status IN ('PRO', 'BILL', 'RECT')) AND nt.bill_id IS NULL

select a.gh_id,c.gh_name,a.block_id,a.block_name,count(case when mode_of_req='PUB' then req_id end) as total_application_online, count(case when mode_of_req!='PUB' then req_id end) as total_application_offline, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL' or status='RECT') and (purpose='1') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_official, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL' or status='RECT') and (purpose='2') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_private, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL' or status='RECT') and (purpose='3') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_patient, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT') and (purpose='4') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_student, count(case when (status='PCIN' or status='BILL' or status='RECT' or status='CIN' or status='COUT') and req_id IN(select req_id from tr_checkin where (status='CIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL')) and (purpose in ('1', '2', '3', '4')) then req_id end) as total_occupancy from room_block a left join gad_request b on a.block_id = b.block_id

select count(case when mode_of_req='PUB' then req_id end) as total_application_online, count(case when mode_of_req!='PUB' then req_id end) as total_application_offline, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL' or status='RECT') and (purpose='1') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_official, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL' or status='RECT') and (purpose='2') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_private, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL' or status='RECT') and (purpose='3') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_patient, count(case when (status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT') and (purpose='4') and req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment where ( status='PRO' or status='CIN' or status='PCIN' or status='COUT')) then req_id end) as total_allotment_student, count(case when (status='PCIN' or status='BILL' or status='RECT' or status='CIN' or status='COUT') and req_id IN(select req_id from tr_checkin where (status='CIN' or status='COUT' or status='BILL')) and (purpose in ('1', '2', '3', '4')) then req_id end) as total_occupancy from gad_request b

select a.nu_of_rooms as total_no_of_rooms, a.gh_id,c.gh_name,a.block_id,a.block_name, count(case when mode_of_req='PUB' then b.req_id end) as total_application_online, count(case when mode_of_req!='PUB' then b.req_id end) as total_application_offline,
count(case when (b.status='PRO' or b.status='CIN' or b.status='PCIN' or b.status='COUT' or b.status='BILL' or b.status='RECT') and mode_of_req='PUB' and b.req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment ta where ( ta.status='PRO' or ta.status='CIN' or ta.status='PCIN' or ta.status='COUT')) then b.req_id end) as total_allotment_online,
count(case when (b.status='PRO' or b.status='CIN' or b.status='PCIN' or b.status='COUT' or b.status='BILL' or b.status='RECT') and mode_of_req!='PUB' and b.req_id IN (select req_id from tr_allotment ta where ( ta.status='PRO' or ta.status='CIN' or ta.status='PCIN' or ta.status='COUT')) then b.req_id end) as total_allotment_offline,
count(case when (b.status='PCIN' or b.status='BILL' or b.status='RECT' or b.status='CIN' or b.status='COUT') and b.req_id IN(select req_id from feedback_system )then b.req_id end) as feedback_received,
count(case when (b.status='PCIN' or b.status='CIN' or b.status='COUT' or b.status='BILL' or b.status='RECT') and b.req_id IN(select req_id from tr_checkin tc where (tc.status IN ('CIN','COUT','BILL')))then b.req_id end) as check_in,
count(case when (b.status='COUT' or b.status='BILL' or b.status='RECT') and b.req_id IN(select req_id from tr_checkin trr where (trr.status IN ('COUT','BILL')))then b.req_id end) as check_out
from room_block a left join gad_request b on a.block_id = b.block_id

SELECT gh.req_id, gh.req_date, gs.name,gh.status, gh.nor_req,gh.nod_g_req, gh.gh_id, ct.gh_name, gh.block_id, bl.block_name, gh.from_date ,gh.to_date FROM gad_request AS gh LEFT JOIN gh_details AS ct ON ct.gh_id= gh.gh_id LEFT JOIN room_block AS bl ON bl.block_id= gh.block_id INNER JOIN (select req_id,STRING_AGG((SELECT CONCAT(name,CASE WHEN designation <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', designation) ELSE '' END,CASE WHEN address <> '' THEN CONCAT(',', address) ELSE '' END)),' & ' order by guest_id)as name from guest_details group by req_id) AS gs ON gh.req_id = gs.req_id

WITH tr_dues_cte AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (tbvg.req_id) tbvg.req_id, trd.rec_id, trd.status AS dues_status FROM tr_receiptvsbill trvb JOIN tr_billvsguest tbvg ON tbvg.bill_id = trvb.bill_id JOIN tr_dues trd ON trd.rec_id = trvb.rec_id) SELECT * FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.req_id ORDER BY gd.guest_id) AS i, gd.name,a.req_id,a.roomtype,a.mobile_no,a.during_stay_conveancy, COALESCE(a.from_date, k.arrival_time) AS from_date,COALESCE(a.to_date, l.arrival_time) AS to_date, a.req_date,a.status,a.purpose,a.nor_req,a.nob_g_req,a.nod_g_req,a.is_veh_req,a.is_veh_req1,d.quota_desc, b.gh_name,c.block_name,c.block_id,e.item_title,a.can_status,f.feedback_id,td.dues_status FROM gad_request a JOIN room_block c ON a.block_id = c.block_id JOIN gh_details b ON a.gh_id = b.gh_id JOIN quota d ON a.category_type = d.quota_type JOIN m_purpose_items e ON e.item_id = a.purpose JOIN guest_details gd ON a.req_id = gd.req_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_req k ON a.req_id = k.req_id LEFT JOIN vehicle_req1 l ON a.req_id = l.req_id LEFT JOIN feedback_system f ON a.req_id = f.req_id LEFT JOIN tr_dues_cte td ON a.req_id = td.req_id WHERE userid = :userId AND a.roomtype != 'CON' AND (a.status NOT IN ('CAN') OR (a.status = 'CAN' AND a.can_status IS NOT NULL))
